lines.1: 「The third-year floor makes me kind of nervous.」
lines.2: 「Really? It's just a gathering of old geezers.」
lines.3: 「You came quickly. Challenging me the very same day, after all that crying this morning.」
lines.4: 「I'm bursting with energy now! I feel great. And I didn't cry!」
lines.5: 「You feel better because I adjusted you while I had you in that hold this morning.」
lines.6: 「Your spine was showing signs of a slight curve. Sit up straight when you're in a chair.」
lines.8: 「Hahaha! She turned it right back into a lecture. What an idiot.」
lines.9: 「...I was going to look for a weakness first, but forget all this roundabout stuff... I'll hit her head-on.」
lines.11: 「No matter what happens, I would never lay a hand on a beautiful woman.」
lines.12: 「I'll introduce you to a cute friend of mine.」
lines.14: 「Did you learn nothing from this morning?」
lines.16: 「Once I get serious, nobody can stop me!」
lines.17: 「I can turn any wildcat into a kitten.」
lines.18: 「I have no idea what you are trying to say, but very well.」
lines.19: 「If someone refuses to understand words, I do not object to using force. I may not look it, but I am an athlete.」
lines.20: 「Heh. Hook the leg, take her down, then lock in a side-control hold... Hehehe.」
lines.22: 「A national champion or not, she's still a woman! She can only yield before a man's strength! Here I come!」
